title: 30A East Paradise Cove Inlet Beach, FL Stay at 30A Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Beach Home!* Private Heated Pool and Hot Tub w/Sun Shelf * 4 Complimentary Bikes * Multiple Balconies – Enjoy the coastal setting...
description_expanded: Overview5.0(7 reviews)Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Beach Home!* Private Heated Pool and Hot Tub w/Sun Shelf * 4 Complimentary Bikes * Multiple Balconies – Enjoy the coastal setting and peaceful Inlet Beach surroundings* Elevator – Convenient access to all three levels of the home* Pet Friendly (add'l $250 fee, 1 pet under 15lbs)* Arcade games for everyone to enjoy* Walk to the Private Beach – Access via the Lupine Beach Neighborhood Beach Walkover. Please Note: Beach access is via the Lupine Beach Neighborhood Beach Walkover. The beach walkover includes stairs and is not handicap accessible.* Peaceful Inlet Beach Location -Minutes from 30A Dining and Boutique Shopping. Enjoy convenient access to restaurants, shops, and coastal attractions* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. ** The neighborhood is growing, and construction may be taking place nearby, including in front of the home. Construction is outside of our control, and we want to be upfront so there are no surprises during your stay. We appreciate your understanding as this beautiful area continues to develop.** Smart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, pool/spa heater controls, a decibel meter, and video surveillance, including the front door and pool area.**We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs November thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Welcome to Paradise Cove, a luxurious three-story beach retreat tucked away in the peaceful Inlet Beach area! With 8 bedrooms, 8 full bathrooms, 2 half bathrooms, and accommodations for up to 27 guests, this impressive home is designed for unforgettable family vacations. Step outside and enjoy your own private outdoor oasis featuring a heated pool and spa with a sun shelf. Paradise Cove also includes 4 complimentary bikes, making it easy to explore the neighborhood, cruise along 30A, or enjoy a scenic ride toward the beach. Inside combines upscale coastal design with the space and amenity needs for a large group. The home features elegant décor, top-tier finishes, Smart TVs, WiFi, a gourmet kitchen, and an elevator providing easy access across all three levels. Sleeping arrangements are ideal for large groups, with 7 King bedrooms and an expansive bunk room featuring 3 King beds, 1 Queen bed, and 4 Twin beds. With a total sleeping capacity of 27 guests, everyone can enjoy a comfortable place to unwind after a day at the beach. Paradise Cove offers the perfect combination of luxury, comfort, and coastal charm.The Bed Setup:1st Floor:Guest Bedroom: King Bed with Ensuite BathroomGuest Bedroom: King Bed with Ensuite BathroomGuest Bedroom: King Bed with Ensuite Bathroom2nd Floor:Guest Bedroom: King Bed with Ensuite BathroomGuest Bedroom: King Bed with Ensuite Bathroom3rd Floor:Master Bedroom: King Bed with Ensuite BathroomGuest Bedroom: King Bed with Ensuite BathroomBunk Room: 3 King Beds, 1 Queen Bed and 4 Twin BedsArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy!Show less
